Cons.Name: Know Thy Self, Know Thy Enemy
Cons.Effect: When any squad member inflicts an Anomaly on an enemy, Yanagi gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Clarity</color>, lasting 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon being hit by an enemy attack, Yanagi consumes 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Clarity</color> to gain invulnerability for 1s. When Yanagi has 1 or more stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Clarity</color>, her Anomaly Proficiency increases by 80.

Cons.Name: Outstanding Adaptability
Cons.Effect: During her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the rapid thrust's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup</color> increases by 20%. Holding down the Special Attack button after a rapid thrust hits an enemy will consume 10 additional Energy to launch another thrust. If Energy is insufficient or the button is released, the attack automatically follows up with the downward attack. When the downward attack hits an enemy suffering an Anomaly and triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>, the DMG multiplier increases to 20% of the original <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect. Each additional thrust increases this multiplier by 15%, up to a maximum of 2 extra thrusts.

Cons.Name: Chessmaster
Cons.Effect: When Yanagi inflicts Attribute Anomaly DMG on an enemy, they suffer the <color=#FFFFFF>Exposed</color> effect, lasting 15s. Attacks on enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Expose</color> effect will have 16% increased PEN Ratio.

Cons.Name: Inhuman Blood
Cons.Effect: After a thrust attack during her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the duration of the <color=#FFFFFF>Shinrabanshou</color> state increases to 30s. While the state is active, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> DMG increases by 20%. The maximum number of times the additional DMG multiplier increase effect for <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> in <color=#FFFFFF>Outstanding Adaptability</color> can be triggered increases to 4, and the Energy cost for the first 4 additional thrust attacks is halved.
